notes: *qatep 'roof' > atep (standard Malay hatap, atap), against *umpan > umpan; 'la distribution d'e et a en malais jakartanais correspond assez nettement avec la distribution de *e et *a en austronésien commun' (p. 47). Grijns (1991: 4-5) explains these e as Javanese, Balinese or Sundanese influence. Stated against the Proto-Malayic schwa: Smith (2017a) has PMP *ə > PM *a in this position, Adelaar (1992) keeps PM *ə (decision adelaar1994b-jakarta).
